cards.name: Amazoness Chain Master
cards.effectSummary: When destroyed by battle and sent to the GY, its controller may pay 1500 LP, inspect the opponent's hand, and add one monster from that hand to their own hand.

twoVTwoAdaptation.lifePoints: 1500 is deducted from the resolving team's shared LP
twoVTwoAdaptation.opponentSeat: passed explicitly from the battle event as the seat controlling the monster that destroyed Amazoness Chain Master; no opponent hand is inferred
twoVTwoAdaptation.handPrivacy: full opponent hand projection is visible only to effectPlayerSeat; the selected card identity is visible only to effectPlayerSeat and opponentSeat; team partners and public output receive no card identity
twoVTwoAdaptation.physicalOwnership: the stolen card keeps physicalOwnerSeat; only holderSeat changes to effectPlayerSeat
twoVTwoAdaptation.edgeCases: source cards whose physical owner team differs from the resolving team are rejected; stolen-control trigger ownership needs a separate rules decision before integration

behavioralGroups: optional 1500 team LP payment and decline/insufficient LP
explicit 2v2 opponent seat and private hand ownership
single monster transfer with physical owner preservation
transfer identity visibility restricted to the two directly involved seats
stale UID, duplicate UID, no-monster-at-resolution and no-mutation guards
